editorial: You will feel the roar of engines and the sting of dread the moment your GPS drops the family camp into a gun‑laden nightmare. Colonel Lee Gunner, a war‑scarred veteran, raises his boys to connect, but his quiet stoicism cracks when a biker gang unleashes a drug smuggling siege. The film's handheld camera turns every woodland frame into a claustrophobic battleground that rattles the nerves. A lull in the middle third lets the adrenaline subside, but the final showdown makes up for the brief drag. You will relish it if you thrive on raw action tempered by a father’s desperate love.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high‑energy action that crackles with family stakes.
